title: Legislative Department and Department of Legal Affairs Take Integrity Pledge to Mark Vigilance Awareness Week
body_text: As part of the observance of Vigilance Awareness Week 2026, officers and officials of the Legislative Department and the Department of Legal Affairs, Ministry of Law and Justice, took the Integrity Pledge administered by Dr. Manoj Kumar, Additional Secretary, Legislative Department, at Hall No. 24000-B, Kartavya Bhawan-2, New Delhi, today. The pledge reaffirmed the collective commitment of both departments to upholding the highest standards of honesty, integrity and ethical conduct in the discharge of official duties, while fostering a culture of transparency, accountability, fairness and good governance in public administration. On the occasion, officers and officials reiterated their resolve to discharge their responsibilities with sincerity, impartiality and a strong sense of public service, while safeguarding the rights and interests of citizens and society at large. The observance underscored the importance of vigilance, ethical conduct and individual accountability in preventing corruption, strengthening institutional integrity and sustaining public trust in government institutions. The initiative reflects the Ministry of Law and Justice's continued commitment to integrity, probity and transparency in public administration, reinforcing the principle that ethical governance and public accountability are fundamental to effective and citizen-centric public service. *** Samrat/Sagar/Pranab
